questions.question: Who has taken over charge as the Chairman of the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) from 1 January 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri A. K. Balasubrahmanian.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Shri A. K. Balasubrahmanian has taken over charge as Chairman of the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board on January 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Shri A. K. Balasubrahmanian succeeded Dr. D. K. Shukla as Chairman of AERB.**
 
• He is a Distinguished Scientist and Fellow of the Indian National Academy of Engineering.
 
• He has nearly 40 years of experience in nuclear power plant design, safety and commissioning.
 
• Professional Background__ 
 __
 
• Former Director (Technical), NPCIL
 
• Chairman of Project Design Safety Committee for PHWR-based NPPs
 
• Member, Safety Review Committee for Operating Plants of AERB
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB)__

 __
 
• Constituted on 15 November 1983
 
• Formed under the Atomic Energy Act, 1962
 
• Ensures nuclear and radiation safety in India
 
 
 
• Pressurised Heavy Water Reactor (PHWR)__
 __
 
• Indigenously developed nuclear reactor technology
 
• Uses heavy water as moderator and coolant
 
• Major backbone of India’s nuclear power programme
 
 
 
• Mission of AERB__
 
 
• Protect people from risks of ionising radiation
 
• Ensure safety of nuclear energy use
 
• Safeguard environment and public health

International Year for Rangelands and Pastoralists

questions.question: Which of the following rare migratory birds of prey was recently spotted at Mudumalai Tiger Reserve during the 2025–26 winter season?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Eastern Imperial Eagle**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• A rare Eastern Imperial Eagle was sighted at Mudumalai Tiger Reserve in Tamil Nadu during the 2025–26 winter season, confirming the reserve’s importance as a winter refuge for long-distance migratory raptors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Scientific Name: **Aquila heliaca**; Family: Accipitridae; Subfamily: Aquilinae.
 
• Breeds in southeastern Europe, West and Central Asia; migrates south to northeastern Africa, Middle East, and South & East Asia during winter.
 
• Second largest eagle in Europe; wingspan up to 2.14 m; shows reverse sexual dimorphism.
 
• Diet: Predatory bird controlling rodent and small mammal populations; presence indicates a healthy ecosystem.
 
• Conservation Status: **Vulnerable** on the IUCN Red List.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Mudumalai Tiger Reserve is located in Nilgiris district, Tamil Nadu, covering 321 sq. km, and is part of the Nilgiris Biosphere Reserve.
 
• The reserve features open grasslands, forest edges, tall nesting trees, and abundant prey, attracting migratory raptors.
 
• Recent sightings also included the endangered Egyptian vulture alongside the Eastern Imperial Eagle, highlighting ecological significance.
 
• Conservationists warn that increasing tourism could disturb sensitive habitats; sustainable tourism practices are needed to protect wildlife.

questions.question: Rani Velu Nachiyar, celebrated for her bravery and leadership, was born in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1730.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Rani Velu Nachiyar, the first Indian queen to actively resist the British East India Company, was born in 1730 in Ramanathapuram, Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Born in 1730, she was the daughter of the ruler of the Ramnad kingdom and well educated in languages and martial skills.**
 
• Married to the ruler of Sivagangai kingdom, she formed alliances with Hyder Ali and Gopala Nayaker to resist the British.
 
• She formed an army including women soldiers and successfully reclaimed the Sivagangai kingdom after defeating British forces.
 
• Known as **Veeramangai** in Tamil history, she is remembered for bravery, leadership, and anti-colonial resistance; her birth anniversary is observed on 3 January.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar__

 __
 
• First Indian queen to wage armed resistance against the British East India Company, decades before the 1857 Revolt.
 
• Trained in martial arts, horse riding, and weaponry from a young age.
 
• Proficient in multiple languages and strategically skilled in forming alliances.
 
 
 
• Sivagangai Kingdom__
 __
 
• Rani Velu Nachiyar married the ruler of Sivagangai and later reclaimed the kingdom after British occupation.
 
• Her military leadership included organizing women soldiers in her army.
 
 
 
• Legacy__
 
 
• Remembered as a symbol of women’s leadership, courage, and anti-colonial resistance.
 
• The title **Veeramangai** honors her valor in Tamil history and cultural memory.

questions.question: Which Indian athlete announced his retirement in 2026 after winning gold in the 1500m at the 2018 Asian Games and breaking multiple national records?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jinson Johnson.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian middle-distance runner Jinson Johnson announced his retirement from competitive athletics in 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **He won the 1500m gold medal at the 2018 Jakarta Asian Games with a timing of 3:44.72.**
 
• **At the same Asian Games, he also secured a silver medal in the 800m event.**
 
• **In 2018, he broke the 42-year-old national 800m record in Guwahati with a time of 1:45.65.**
 
• **He set and later improved the national 1500m record, clocking 3:37.86 at the 2018 Commonwealth Games and 3:35.24 at the 2019 Berlin Meeting.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The 34-year-old athlete from Kerala represented India at major international events including the Asian Games and Commonwealth Games.**
 
• **His retirement marked the end of a career that significantly elevated India’s presence in middle-distance running.**

questions.question: Which country did India overtake to become the world’s largest rice producer?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India surpassed China to become the world’s largest rice producer, achieving 150.18 million tonnes compared to China’s 145.28 million tonnes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Rice production growth attributed to improved irrigation, high-yielding varieties, and better farming practices.**
 
• India now exports rice globally, contributing to higher export earnings.
 
• Union Agriculture Minister unveiled 184 improved crop varieties across 25 field crops, including cereals, pulses, oilseeds, and fodder crops.
 
• New seeds are high-yielding, climate-resilient, and pest-resistant, supporting sustainable agriculture and improving farmer income.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Rice Production__

 __
 
• India produced 150.18 million tonnes of rice, becoming the world leader.
 
• China’s rice production stood at 145.28 million tonnes.
 
 
 
• Improved Crop Varieties__
 __
 
• 184 new varieties unveiled covering cereals, pulses, oilseeds, fodder crops, sugarcane, cotton, jute, and tobacco.
 
• Varieties are climate-resilient, pest-resistant, and high-yielding, promoting sustainable agriculture.
 
 
 
• Agricultural Impact__
 __
 
• Enhanced productivity, higher farmer incomes, and strengthened food security.
 
• Represents a technological and innovation-driven phase of India’s agricultural development.
 
 
 
• Global Trade__
 
 
• India’s increased production supports export markets, boosting foreign exchange earnings.
 
• Strategic positioning enhances India’s role as a key global rice supplier.

questions.question: Which Indian city is continuing its efforts to become the country’s first fully slum-free city due to sustained urban planning and effective housing schemes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Surat.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Surat is on track to become India’s first fully slum-free city through large-scale housing redevelopment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Surat is poised to become India’s first slum-free city.**
 
• The city adopted in-situ redevelopment of slum areas into planned housing complexes.
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana played a key role in providing permanent housing.
 
• Urban growth has been balanced with inclusive development despite high migration.
 
• **Chandigarh **officially recognized as India's first slum-free city in **October 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Surat Municipal Corporation Strategy__

 __
 
• Focused on permanent housing for all residents.
 
• Ensured access to civic amenities like water, drainage and roads.
 
• Redevelopment allowed residents to stay near workplaces.
 
 
 
• Housing Schemes__
 __
 
• Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana supported affordable housing.
 
• Targeted Economically Weaker Sections and lower-income groups.
 
• Thousands of families rehabilitated into durable homes.
 
 
 
• Urban Significance__
 
 
• Surat is a major textile and diamond-processing hub.
 
• Faces high migrant inflow due to industrial growth.
 
• Emerging as a national model for slum-free urban development.

questions.question: According to an international study, oceans absorbed the most heat on record in which year?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2025.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **An international study reported that oceans absorbed the highest amount of heat ever recorded in 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The study, published in Advances in Atmospheric Sciences, found a rise of 23 zettajoules in ocean heat content.**
 
• **This heat gain is equivalent to 37 years of global energy use at 2023 consumption levels.**
 
• **The upper 2,000 metres of oceans recorded the highest heat content, confirming a long-term warming trend.**
 
• **Fastest warming was observed in the Tropical & South Atlantic, North Pacific, and Southern Ocean.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The study involved over 50 scientists from 31 institutions across Asia, Europe and the Americas.**
 
• **Sea-surface temperatures in 2025 were the third highest on record, intensifying floods, droughts and extreme weather.**

questions.question: Cyprus assumed the rotating presidency of the European Union for a six-month term beginning in which city?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nicosia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Cyprus assumed the rotating presidency of the European Union with a high-level meeting held in Nicosia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **This is the second time Cyprus has held the EU Council presidency since joining the EU in 2004.**
 
• **The inauguration meeting in Nicosia was attended by Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskiy, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President Antonio Costa.**
 
• **Cyprus highlighted its role as a bridge between Europe and the Middle East, with regional leaders attending the ceremony.**
 
• **The presidency focuses on strengthening EU autonomy and advancing European integration amid global challenges.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Zelenskiy’s participation signalled continued EU support for Ukraine as the Russia-Ukraine war enters its fourth year.**
 
• **Cypriot President Nikos Christodoulides emphasised EU strategic autonomy as a key priority of the presidency.**

questions.question: Which state became the first in India to constitute the 8th State Pay Commission even before the expiry of the 7th Pay Commission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Assam became the first state in India to constitute the 8th State Pay Commission, with the decision announced by Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The 8th State Pay Commission of Assam was constituted before the expiry of the 7th Pay Commission, which ends on January 1, 2026.**
 
• The commission is chaired by **Subhas Das**, former Chief Secretary of Assam.
 
• The Pay Commission will review **salaries, allowances, and pensions** of state government employees.
 
• The revision will consider **inflation, economic conditions, and the state’s fiscal capacity**, potentially leading to faster pay revision.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Pay Commission__

 __
 
• A Pay Commission is a government-appointed body that reviews and recommends changes in pay structure of government employees.
 
• It examines salaries, allowances, pensions, and service conditions.
 
• Recommendations are advisory in nature and require government approval.
 
 
 
• Implementation Timeline__
 __
 
• Pay Commission reports generally take around **18 months** to be finalized.
 
• Actual implementation in Assam is expected in **late 2026 or early 2027**.
 
 
 
• Significance of Assam’s Decision__
 
 
• Assam moved ahead of other states and the Centre, where the **8th Central Pay Commission** has not yet been initiated.
 
• The early setup may benefit employees and pensioners through quicker revisions.
